## Korean chipmakers face growing external calls to improve shareholder returns

Sustained capital-return pressure on the two dominant Korean chip names could surface shareholder-friendly actions that support valuations independent of memory cycle timing; worth monitoring alongside HBM demand and dividend-policy updates.

- External voices are increasingly calling on Korean chipmakers to enhance capital returns to shareholders.
- Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are the primary large-cap Korean semiconductor names this pressure applies to.
- No specific shareholder-return programs or company responses are disclosed in the headline.
- Directional read is constructive for dividend or buyback optionality, though no concrete actions are announced.
